task_title: Automate Goobers issue triggers and recovery

plan_review.notes: Adopted static cross-event defaults for every inputs.* use, exact expression assertions, trusted default-branch checkout, and updates to both READMEs. Rejected full Actions-level reruns because terminal replay can duplicate side effects; retries stay within the same Goobers run via maxRepasses=2 plus maxAttempts=2 only on plan, implement, and review, while hourly scheduling provides cross-run rediscovery.

code_review.notes: Added exact non-issues pass-through and terminal-sink assertions. Rejected replay/injection, self-context, and unbounded-loop claims after verifying quoted argv, pre-existing intentional context, and v0.2.2 maxRepasses semantics. Round-2 action-version concern was pre-existing outside the diff and invalid for the repository date; no validated findings remain.
